description: Ministry of Defence - The Name Lists of Personnel approved for the awards of the Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel (both officers and airmen) for completing 12 years of service. This falls under public service matters related to military service awards and recognition, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) covering public sector service conditions and benefits.
